battle.name: 張大彪
battle.brief: 隋煬帝大業九年冬末至十年正月再宿江都，宿衛與市井百姓不堪徭役，張大彪、宗世模起兵於城內，封門檻、斷漕船，隋廷遣將平叛。城頭弩兵與叛軍弓箭手隔街交射，卡面這件亞述長弓所代表的角弓族弓兵，正是雙方真正決定射程的兵器。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 這場衝突發生在大業十年的隋朝江都。交戰一方是隋廷的中央軍與江都留守官府：隋朝以十二衛宿衛京師與陪都，江都自大業元年起被定為煬帝行在，左右翊衛、武衛、殿內衛與宮掖宿衛常駐城內，郡縣另置鄉兵與縣兵，江都又因漕運而聚集數萬船工、役夫與衛士。另一方是起兵者：最初由禁軍中受命於張大彪、宗世模的部眾構成，後來得到城內坊市居民、造船與運河役夫以及流落江南的東征逃卒加入，沒有固定編制，靠奪取武器、糧食與船隻維持。官軍方面，調動的是江都本地宿衛與從上游驛路趕來的郡兵，江都宮掖監系統掌握城門與宮門的啟閉，郡縣官員則負責搜捕與勸降。兩軍同在城內巷陌與城門一帶作戰，分界線幾乎就是隋廷對江都控制力的實際範圍：城門與宮門在隋廷手中，坊市與河埠在起義者手中。
countriesEn: This clash took place at Jiangdu in the Sui state during the tenth year of the Daye era. On one side stood the Sui court itself: the imperial guards and the resident administration of the city. The Sui organised its garrison into twelve wei units, with the Left and Right Yiwei and Wuwei, the diannei guard and the palace regiments stationed at Jiangdu because the city had been made the emperor's standing residence from the first year of Daye; counties and commanderies kept their own local militia, and because Jiangdu was the southern terminus of the canal transport, tens of thousands of boatmen, porters and soldiers were gathered in and around the city. On the other side stood the insurgents, drawn at first from the guard units that sided with Zhang Dabiao and Zong Shimo and afterwards enlarged by the residents of the ward markets, by the shipwrights and canal labourers, and by deserters who had drifted back from the northern campaigns. They had no standing establishment and lived on whatever arms, grain and boats they could seize. The Sui answered with the garrison of the city itself, the district militia summoned down the post roads, and the palace officials who controlled the opening and closing of the city and palace gates; the counties handled arrests and offers of pardon. The fighting therefore stayed inside the city, along the streets, the water gates and the river landings, and the line between the two sides was in effect the limit of what the court could still control in Jiangdu: the gates were in Sui hands, the wards and the wharves were in the hands of the rebels.
people: 史籍關於此役留下的姓名極少，可以確定的只有起義首領張大彪與宗世模。張大彪在禁軍中任職，宗世模則為江都一帶的武職，兩人於大業九年冬末、大業十年正月在城內起事，號召宿衛與百姓，一度控制江都城內的街坊與碼頭，未聞有大規模的攻城戰。隋煬帝楊廣其時正在江都，他是這場衝突真正要對抗的對象，卻始終沒有親至陣前，把平叛交給江都留守官與未叛的宿衛將領處置。城中另有越王楊侑與一批宗室、宦官，是宮中權力中樞，也是各方覬覦與防範的對象；舊史另記江都宮掖監樊子蓋執法嚴酷、連坐者眾，百姓怨望，叛亂一起，官府平叛的執法基礎十分脆弱。禁軍內部並非一心，張大彪一派只是其中一部，隋廷能平叛，靠的是不叛的宿衛部隊與臨時召集的鄉兵。起義首領的下落只有斬首與懸示城門一類的記載，其餘事蹟多已散佚，名字之外的空白，只能靠隋末大局的走向去補。
peopleEn: The historical record about this rising is thin, and only two names out of it can be treated as certain: the leaders Zhang Dabiao and Zong Shimo. Zhang served in the imperial guard, and Zong was a military officer of the Jiangdu region; the two raised men inside the city in the last months of Daye 9 and the first month of Daye 10, calling up the garrison and the townspeople, and for a time they controlled the streets and the landing stages of Jiangdu without any large assault on the walls. The man they were really opposing was Yang Guang, the Sui Yangdi, who was then residing at Jiangdu; he never came to the fighting himself and left the suppression in the hands of the resident officials and the loyal part of the guard. In the palace, the Prince of Yue, Yang Yu, together with members of the imperial clan and eunuchs, formed the real centre of power, and they were the object of both conspiracy and vigilance. The old histories also describe the supervisor of the Jiangdu palace, Fan Zikai, as a severe enforcer whose sentences brought collective punishment down on many households, which left the local population hostile and the legal basis for repression brittle. The guard was not of one mind: Zhang's faction was only one part of it, and the Sui could put the rising down only by relying on the units that stayed loyal and on hastily enrolled local levies. What survives of the two leaders is their execution and the display of their heads; the rest of their actions is lost.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長弓出自新亞述帝國，約公元前七百年前後的工藝，是角、筋、木三層複合的長弓，靠弓背貼角、弓腹納筋取得張力，箭長約六十至七十公分，亞述弓兵不持重盾，靠前排跪姿、後排立姿的交替輪射維持箭幕。江都城頭的弓兵用的正是同一族系的角弓：中國角弓在形制上承襲西亞與中亞的複合弓傳統，隋制步卒以角弓為主弓，配箭一囊、刀一、盾一或小槊，弓手在隊列中輪射，掩護持矛持刀的步兵推進。弩是守城與壓制街巷的重火力，蹶張弩靠人力張弦，可及二百步以上，臂張弩以槓杆張弦，弩手居城門與木樓之上，向街口與坊門封鎖。攻城用的撞車、雲梯與火攻器材在隋代已有定制，但此役是城內起事，雙方都沒有大型攻城器可用，役夫與船工手上的工具反而成為叛軍最現成的武器。江都的水道、邗溝與揚子津一線的河埠、浮橋，是糧食與兵員進出的通道，叛軍控制河埠，等於卡住城內部分糧食與消息的來源。亞述長弓並不會出現在大業十年的江都，但它正是隋軍與叛軍手上真正決定射程的那件兵器的直系祖先。
kitsEn: The card weapon, an Assyrian long bow, belongs to the Neo-Assyrian state of roughly the seventh century BCE. It is a composite bow of horn, sinew and wood, the horn laid on the back and the sinew on the belly to store the draw, and its arrows run to some sixty or seventy centimetres. Assyrian archers fought without heavy shields, maintaining a curtain of arrows by alternating a kneeling front rank with a standing rear rank; the archers on the walls of Jiangdu used bows of exactly the same composite family, the horn bows of the Sui army. The Chinese horn bow inherits that Western and Central Asian tradition, and Sui infantry were issued a horn bow as their principal weapon, with a quiver of arrows, a sword and either a small shield or a short spear; archers fired in rotation from within the formation while the spearmen and swordsmen advanced behind them. The crossbow was the heavy firepower of defence: the drawn-and-anchored crossbow, cocked by human muscle, could reach more than two hundred paces, and the lever-cocked crossbow was worked from the gates and timber towers to seal the streets and ward entrances. Siege equipment such as rams, ladders and fire devices existed in the Sui system, but this was a rising inside a city, so neither side had heavy engines to hand; the tools of the labourers and shipwrights were the rebels' readiest weapons. The waterways of Jiangdu, the canals, the landings along them and the pontoon bridges, were the channels through which grain and men moved, and by seizing the landings the insurgents cut part of the city's supply and its lines of information. The Assyrian bow itself never stood in Jiangdu in the tenth year of Daye, but it is the direct ancestor of the very weapon that decided the range of the fight on both sides.
tactics: 城內起事講究的是節點控制。叛軍起事之後先封江都諸門與浮橋，把宿衛分割在城內各坊，再用坊牆、廟宇與官署的院牆作掩體逐段推進；官軍退守宮城與城門一線，以弓弩占據高處，先用弩封住通往宮門的寬街，再以步騎反擊。巷戰與守城都受制於箭程：角弓有效射程約在百步上下，弩可及二百步以上，雙方都靠隔街對射與屋頂轉移陣地來爭奪地勢，弓手退到街口重新站位，再由持矛的步兵跟進。隋煬帝的應手並非一味鎮壓：舊史記他遣人宣諭，許諾赦免黨羽並賞賜首領，部分起事者因此放下兵器；叛軍內部因賞格分配與糧食短缺而分化，官軍得以逐坊清剿，最後在城門與刑場收束。起事者中大量是征高句麗的逃卒與沿運河逃亡的役夫，他們熟悉水路與船隻；一旦江都運船被扣，宮中的糧食與消息同時被卡住，這是叛軍最實際的戰術收穫。
tacticsEn: A rising inside a city is fought over its nodes. After the revolt began, the insurgents closed the gates and the pontoon bridges of Jiangdu, cut the loyal garrison into separate wards, and used ward walls, temple precincts and the courtyard walls of public offices as cover to advance section by section. The Sui forces fell back on the palace city and the gates, held the heights with bows and crossbows, sealed the broad streets to the palace gate with crossbow fire first, and then counterattacked with foot and horse. Both street fighting and the defence of the walls were governed by the range of missiles: a horn bow was effective to about a hundred paces, a crossbow to more than two hundred, so both sides fought by firing down streets and by shifting position over rooftops to seize high ground, archers withdrawing to a street mouth, re-forming, and letting the spearmen follow. The emperor's response was not one of unqualified repression. The old histories record that he sent emissaries to proclaim amnesty, promised pardon to the rank and file and reward to the leaders, and that some of the insurgents laid down their arms; divisions within the rebel ranks over the sharing of rewards and over short supplies allowed the loyal troops to clear ward by ward and to close the matter at the gates and the execution ground. Many of the insurgents were deserters from the campaigns against Goguryeo and porters who had fled along the canal; they knew the water routes and the boats, and once the grain junks at Jiangdu were held, the food and the news of the palace were held at the same time. That was the insurgents' most practical tactical gain.
data: 可以核實的數字大致如下：隋煬帝在位十四年，大業紀年自六〇五年起算，大業九年冬宿江都，大業十年正月詔第三次征高句麗，同年江都起事。隋朝最盛時全國約八百九十萬戶、四千六百餘萬口（《隋書·食貨志》）；大運河開通後每年自江南運米百餘萬石，隋末洛陽倉儲以巨萬計，江都一線的漕船與役夫因此常年保持在數萬之眾。城防方面，江都有水陸數門與沿河的水門，宿衛禁軍以數千計，叛軍起事時可拉的弓手，舊史沒有留下確數，據當時的丁口與坊市密度推估，參與者初起以百計，最盛時聚眾至數千。射程方面，亞述長弓有效射程估計在一百五十至二百公尺，隋制角弓約百步，蹶張弩可及二百步以上。亞述長弓重約一公斤上下，箭矢約六十至七十公分，隋代角弓形制略小，箭長在六十公分上下，弓手腰繫箭囊，一次攜箭二十至三十支。役事方面，開皇以來營建東都、洛陽與開通運河所動用的丁夫，前後不下數百萬人次，這些人丁的來源正是江淮與江南，也是起事者最直接的來路。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are roughly these. Yangdi reigned for fourteen years, with the Daye era counted from 605; he was at Jiangdu in the last winter of Daye 9, and in the first month of Daye 10 he ordered a third campaign against Goguryeo, the rising at Jiangdu falling in the same year. At the height of Sui prosperity the empire had about 8.9 million households and some 46 million people, as recorded in the Treatise on Revenue and the Treatise on Food of the Book of Sui; after the Grand Canal was opened, more than a million piculs of rice a year were brought down from the south, and by the end of the dynasty the granaries of Luoyang held rice in tens of millions of piculs, so the river traffic and the labour it employed at Jiangdu numbered tens of thousands. On the defensive side the city had several land gates and water gates along the river, the resident guard counted in the low thousands, and the number of archers the insurgents could raise is not recorded; judged from the population of the wards and the market density, participants ran to hundreds at the start and to several thousands at most at the height. In terms of range, the Assyrian long bow is estimated to be effective at 150 to 200 metres, the Sui horn bow at about a hundred paces, and the drawn crossbow at more than two hundred paces. An Assyrian bow weighs on the order of a kilogram and its arrows run sixty to seventy centimetres; the Sui horn bow is slightly smaller, with arrows around sixty centimetres, and the archer carried a quiver of twenty to thirty arrows. As for the labour: building the eastern capital, Luoyang, and opening the canal drew on millions of man-days of corvée service, and those men came from precisely the Yangzi and Jiangnan districts that hosted the rising.
cause: 起因是多層的。第一層是役：隋煬帝自大業元年起先後三次以上巡幸江都，每一次都建宮室、造龍舟、備儀仗，龍舟高十餘丈，江都及沿運河的丁夫年年被徵，舟師、雜役與宮匠的編派沒有休止。第二層是兵：三征高句麗，大業十年正月又下詔再征，數十萬北征之師在遼東與高句麗戰線崩潰，逃卒大批南流，流入江都與沿江州縣，既帶走了軍械，也帶走了對朝廷的恐懼。第三層是江都本身的怨望：漕運把江南的米、鹽、鐵與人力一齊抽到運河與宮城，本地百姓負擔最重；宮掖監一類的執法者以嚴刑催辦，連坐者眾，民間怨氣已到一觸即發的地步。第四層是宮中的人事：越王楊侑與宦官、宗室在江都，暗中籌劃，舊史還記大業末年曾有謀弒帝的陰謀流傳；禁軍各部對立功與宿衛獎賞的分配不滿，於是張大彪、宗世模得以用一句改朝換代的口號，把不滿湊成隊伍。制度上的原因是：隋朝用強兵與重刑維持的秩序，缺少讓役夫與逃卒退回原位的出口，一旦皇帝本人留在這座城裡，政治危機便直接變成街巷裡的槍兵。
causeEn: The causes were layered. The first was labour: from the first year of Daye the Sui Yangdi toured Jiangdu more than three times, and each tour brought palace building, the great dragon ships, the imperial guard and the ceremonial apparatus; the ships stood more than thirty feet high, and the boat crews, general labour and palace craftsmen of Jiangdu and the canal were levied year after year without pause. The second was war: three campaigns against Goguryeo, and a fresh order for a third one in the first month of Daye 10; the northern armies broke up on the Liao Dong and Goguryeo fronts, and large numbers of deserters drifted south into Jiangdu and the counties along the river, carrying away arms and taking the court's fear with them. The third was the resentment of Jiangdu itself: the canal drained the rice, salt, iron and labour of the south into the waterway and the palace city, and the local population bore the heaviest share; enforcers of the kind of Fan Zikai pressed the levies with severe law and collective sentences, and the mood in the city was one short of a spark. The fourth was the politics of the palace: the Prince of Yue, Yang Yu, with eunuchs and members of the clan, were in Jiangdu and were said to be plotting, and the old histories record talk of a plot to kill the emperor in the last years of Daye; the guard's units were also dissatisfied with how rewards for service and for garrison duty were distributed, so that Zhang Dabiao and Zong Shimo could gather resentment into ranks under a call for a change of ruler. The structural reason lies deeper: the order the Sui maintained with massed troops and heavy law had no institutional channel through which corvée porters and deserters could return to their places, and once the emperor himself sat in that city, a political crisis turned directly into pikes in the lanes.
impact: 起義被平下去，隋廷的元氣卻沒有恢復。張大彪、宗世模的首級傳示之後，江都的街市恢復了表面的秩序，但禁軍與宮掖之間的裂痕已經公開：三年之後的大業十一年，隋煬帝在雁門被突厥圍住，解圍靠的是關內勤王之師與裴矩一行說服東突厥南下，而不是江都的宿衛；同年冬他仍執意再赴江都，禁軍的怨望更形尖銳。大業十二年，江都再成行在，役事照舊；大業十四年三月，禁軍與宮中宦官合謀，在同一座城裡發生了江都之變，宇文化及弒隋煬帝，楊侗在江都即位而不能自立，唐王朝隨後於長安建立。從張大彪的失敗到隋室的覆亡，中間只隔了四年，這四年的走向說明：起義本身並沒有改變戰局，它做的是把隋朝最後一次可用來壓制地方的武力提前內耗掉，讓舊的帝室、新的軍頭與新興的州縣三方在廢墟上重新分配權力。對後世而言，這場在史書上只留兩個人名的江都兵變，是隋末崩解的一個縮影：王朝的崩潰往往不是被一場大戰打破，而是從宮門與坊市之間的每一次夜亂開始。
impactEn: The rising was put down, but the court's vigour did not return. After the heads of Zhang Dabiao and Zong Shimo were displayed and the streets of Jiangdu resumed their outward order, the fracture between the guard and the palace had become public. Three years later, in the eleventh year of Daye, the Sui Yangdi was besieged at Yanmen by the Turks and was saved by relief armies from within the passes together with Pei Ju's envoys persuading the Eastern Turks to move south, not by the garrison of Jiangdu. In the winter of the same year he insisted on going south again, and the guard's resentment sharpened. In the twelfth year of Daye Jiangdu was once more his residence, the labour levies went on as before; in the third month of the fourteenth year the guard and the palace eunuchs together engineered the Jiangdu coup, Yuwen Huaji killed the Yangdi, Yang Tong was enthroned at Jiangdu without real power, and the Tang state was then established at Chang'an. From the failure of Zhang Dabiao to the fall of the Sui there were only four years, and their course shows that the rising changed no battle. What it did was consume the last armed force the Sui could use against its own provinces, leaving the old imperial house, the new military strongmen and the rising commanderies to divide power over the ruins. For posterity, this disturbance that the histories record only as two names in a city tells the story of the Sui collapse in miniature: dynasties rarely fall to one great battle, but begin with each night riot between a palace gate and a ward wall.
result: 結果是起義被鎮壓。舊史記載有限，只留下首領被誅、黨羽被分別處置、財物賞給有功將士的結果，未留下戰損、俘虜與日期的完整數目。從結果推斷，叛軍並未攻入宮城，隋廷避免了一場在行在之地被推倒的危機，代價是把江都的河埠、坊市與漕船的指揮權交回禁軍與郡兵手中，並以赦免與賞格換取，招撫多於討伐。隋煬帝沒有因此返洛，也沒有因此放棄南巡；大業十年之後他繼續留在江都與運河沿線，把第三次征高句麗與營建宮室的經費繼續壓在江淮之上，這使同一批役夫與逃卒在幾年後再次集結。四年後的江都之變裡，殺死隋煬帝的宇文化及正是當年這類禁軍武將中的一員，而江都的宮門、浮橋與坊牆，仍然是同一批街道的同一批牆。這場起義在戰爭列表上只佔一行，卻已經把隋朝最後的武裝力量提前暴露在街頭，也提前暴露了它的用途：不待外敵，先自內潰。
resultEn: The result was suppression. The old record is brief: the leaders were executed, the participants were disposed of separately, and property was handed out to the troops that had taken part; no complete figures for losses, prisoners or even dates survive. From what remains, the rebels never broke into the palace city: the Sui avoided the crisis of being overturned in the emperor's own residence, and paid for it by returning control of the wharves, wards and grain junks of Jiangdu to the guard and the district troops, and by buying settlement with amnesty and reward rather than by massacre alone. The Yangdi neither returned to Luoyang nor abandoned his southern tours; after the tenth year of Daye he stayed on in Jiangdu and along the canal, pressing the cost of the third campaign against Goguryeo and of the new palaces onto the same districts of the Yangzi, and the same porters and deserters duly gathered again a few years later. In the Jiangdu coup of 618 the man who killed the Sui Yangdi, Yuwen Huaji, was precisely a guard officer of the same type as those who had risen in 614, and the palace gates, pontoon bridges and ward walls of the city were still the same walls on the same streets. On the list of wars this rising takes up a single line, yet it had already exposed the last armed strength of the Sui in the streets, and exposed its purpose as well: not waiting for an enemy from without, but breaking from within.
